# gcore_cloud_registry (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_registry" "example_cloud_registry" {
  project_id = 0
  region_id = 0
  registry_id = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `registry_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number)
- `region_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Registry creation date-time
- `id` (Number) Registry ID
- `name` (String) Registry name
- `repo_count` (Number) Number of repositories in the registry
- `storage_limit` (Number) Registry storage limit, GiB
- `storage_used` (Number) Registry storage used, bytes
- `updated_at` (String) Registry modification date-time
- `url` (String) Registry url
